name: typography
useFor: Use the Typography parts for page and section headings, leads and articles outside a component. One accent word per headline at most. Use TypographyProse around rendered Markdown (a blog post, docs), TypographyEyebrow for the label above a heading.
source: The Hoplite website's .display, .heading, .lead, .bp-prose (h2, h3, blockquote, code, a) and .bp-list (.bp-list__mark)

title: Typography
description: The site's type: Chakra Petch light headings at 56, 44, 32 and 24px, an 18px light graphite lead, 16px body, the Kode Mono eyebrow, the flat orange accent word, dashed-rule quotes, hexagon-bulleted lists, Kode Mono inline code and a whole-article prose style. A table wider than the column scrolls sideways and fades at the edge it scrolls past (fade-x).
